Hello all, I'm a final-year Master's student at the Indian Institute of Science Education and Research, Tirupati.

I've been working on the topological aspects of quantum channels as part of my thesis work, and out of interest, have previously taken coursework in pure mathematics (real/complex/functional analysis, algebraic topology, differentiable manifolds, representation theory for finite groups).

I have no prior knowledge about Lean and am eager to start learning to use it. I'm also looking for more interesting topics that lie at the intersection of said interests, and hopefully contribute to the community.

Thanks for reading :)
